3: Send you help from the sanctuary, and aid you out of Sion.
4: Remember all your sacrifice, and enrich your whole burnt offering. Pause.
5: Grant you according to your heart, and fulfill all your desire.
6: We will exult in your salvation, and in the name of our God shall we be magnified: the Lord fulfil all your petitions.
7: Now I know that the Lord has saved his Christ: he shall hear him from his holy heaven: the salvation of his right hand is mighty.
8: Some [glory] in chariots, and some in horses: but we will glory in the name of the Lord our God.
9: They are overthrown and fallen: but we are risen, and have been set upright.
10: O Lord, save the king: and hear us in whatever day we call upon you.
